name: claude/snapshot
description: Saves a work-state snapshot for session continuity. Captures what Claude was doing, what's pending, and what comes next — so the next Claude instance can resume without reading 200 lines of MEMORY.md and guessing.

params.name: summary
params.description: What was being worked on — the current task and approach

params.name: pendingWork
params.description: What's unfinished — branches, uncommitted code, failing tests

params.name: nextSteps
params.description: What should happen next — the plan for the next session

params.name: decisions
params.description: Key decisions made this session and why — so the next instance doesn't relitigate them

params.name: issuesWorked
params.description: Comma-separated issue numbers touched this session (e.g. '376,335,317')

params.summary: Fixed 3 Phase 0 bugs: chat/send userId, duplicate tabs, live double-init
params.pendingWork: ORM date handling investigated but deferred to Phase 1
params.nextSteps: Phase 1 code quality — start with #363 switch elimination or #351 magic strings
params.decisions: Moved #360 from Phase 0 to Phase 1 — dates work correctly, not a ship-blocker

examples.notes: Next session runs claude/context + reads latest snapshot to resume instantly
